name: Grep & glob
summary: The agent searches files directly with grep (or ripgrep) for content and glob patterns for file names, then reads what it finds. There is no embedding step and no index to build or keep in sync. Common in coding agents, where exact identifiers and fresh file state matter more than semantic similarity.
how: Agent glob-matches file paths (e.g. src/**/*.ts) to narrow the search space
Agent greps file contents for identifiers, strings or regex patterns
Agent reads the matching files or line ranges into context
Agent follows imports and call sites with further searches until it has enough context
facts: Claude Code (ripgrep-based Grep, Glob, or find/grep via Bash), Cline
None; searches the live file system
Exact and always current, but no semantic matching and more tokens per search
goodFor: Codebases and text repos that change constantly
watchOut: Misses synonyms and paraphrases that embeddings would catch
Uses more tool calls and tokens than an index lookup
Slows down on very large corpora
